topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was browsing through the university's admissions blog, looking for tips or insights that might help prospective students, when I stumbled upon an essay that seemed strikingly familiar. It was mine, the one I'd poured my heart into last year. There it was, under a header about exemplary applications. I read through it, line by line, and it hit me that my words were being used as a model. I hadn't expected this; I thought my essay had just been a part of the application process, swallowed up in the anonymity of thousands of others. Now, it stands out, highlighted and public. It's a bit overwhelming, to be honest. I never imagined my work would end up here, guiding others on their academic journey.
